name: AWS Lambda and Serverless Security Assessment
description: Security assessment of AWS serverless architectures. Covers Lambda function configurations, execution roles, event source mappings, API Gateway integration, Step Functions, and serverless-specific attack surfaces including injection, misconfigured triggers, and over-privileged functions.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to AWS serverless security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands AWS Lambda architecture and serverless security concerns
evidence: Can explain Lambda execution model, triggers, and execution roles
Understands common serverless security risks (OWASP Serverless Top 10)
Familiar with API Gateway authorization mechanisms

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews Lambda configurations and permissions under supervision
evidence: Enumerates Lambda functions and their execution role permissions with guidance
Identifies overly permissive execution roles using lab checklists
Reviews API Gateway configurations for authentication gaps under supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses serverless architecture security and identifies exploitation paths
evidence: Independently reviews Lambda functions for injection vulnerabilities and insecure configurations
Assesses event source trust boundaries and trigger abuse potential
Evaluates serverless application data flows for exposure risks

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex serverless architectures; develops assessment tooling; mentors others
evidence: Assesses complex multi-service serverless workflows (Step Functions, EventBridge)
Develops automated tooling for serverless configuration and code review
Reviews serverless assessment work of junior analysts
Identifies novel attack chains across serverless service boundaries

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab serverless assessment methodology; publishes serverless security research
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's serverless security assessment methodology
Published research on novel serverless attack techniques or defense bypasses
Trains teams on advanced serverless security assessment
Recognized as authority on serverless security

assessment_methods.description: Assess a serverless application with intentional misconfigurations across Lambda, API Gateway, and event sources
Given a serverless architecture diagram and IAM policies, identify all privilege escalation and data exfiltration paths
